action_items: Add Volunteer Specialization multi-select/dropdown to /app/frontend/src/pages/Login.js registration form. Show conditionally when form.role === 'volunteer'. Suggested options (per NGO missions): Education, Healthcare, Environment, Food Distribution, Women Empowerment, Animal Welfare, Clothing Drives. Wire it to form.specializations and pass through in api.post('/auth/register', {..., specializations: form.specializations}). Add data-testid='register-specializations'.
critical_code_review_comments: admin.py is 557 lines — consider splitting Phase 2 features (notifications, promotions, email-blasts, event-reports) into separate route modules for maintainability.

POST /api/admin/events/report sends notification emails inside the request loop with try/except pass — if Resend rate-limits or fails, errors are silently swallowed. Consider background task / retry queue.
Star Hero scoring uses event_reports.count_documents inside an N-loop (one query per attendee) — O(N) DB calls per report. For larger events this could be slow; consider a single aggregate.
Mandatory modal logic: backend marks drive_type='past' AND reported=true on report submission. Pending list filters by date <= today AND reported != true — correct.
Frontend Dashboard.js is 538 lines with most logic inline — split into per-tab components for maintainability.
Login.js registration: Volunteer Specialization UI is MISSING (highest priority gap).

rca_of_the_issue: Volunteer specialization missing in UI: backend models/schemas.py:26 has 'specializations: List[str] = []' and auth.py:71 persists it on registration. Login.js role-selection block (lines 193-208) has Member/Volunteer buttons but no follow-up specializations field. The frontend simply omits sending the field, so all volunteers register with empty specializations. Mitigation: add a multi-select chip/checkbox UI in Login.js step-1 form, wire to form.specializations, send in payload to /auth/register.
